info.title: Helix portal API
info.description: The control-plane API the `helix` CLI, the portal UI and operator automation call. Every route except the configuration bootstrap needs a bearer token.

servers.description: This deployment's portal origin (`helix capabilities` shows it).

get.description: Requires the platform-admin role.

403.description: The caller is not a platform admin (`forbidden`).
The caller is not a platform admin (`forbidden`).

get.description:
Also lists live apps whose slug already contains a blocked term.

Requires the platform-admin role.

200.description: The blocked terms and matching apps.

403.description: The caller is not a platform admin (`forbidden`).

post.description: Requires the platform-admin role.

403.description: The caller is not a platform admin (`forbidden`).

409.description: The term is already blocked (`conflict`).

403.description: The caller is not a platform admin (`forbidden`).

404.description: No blocked term has this id (`not_found`).

get.description:
A read-only view of the deployment's configuration entries.

Requires the platform-admin role.

403.description: The caller is not a platform admin (`forbidden`).

get.summary: Check whether a slug can be used for a new app
get.description: Reports everything app creation would refuse about a slug: a malformed slug, a reserved or blocked term, or a slug already taken. A missing or malformed slug answers 200 with reason `invalid`, not 400.

200.description: Whether the slug is available, and why not.

post.description: The caller becomes the app's owner.

400.description: The request failed validation, the slug is reserved or contains a blocked term, or a requested job type is not available (`validation_failed`).

403.description: This deployment does not allow public or password apps, and one was requested (`forbidden`).

409.description: The slug is already taken (`slug_taken`).

get.description: `scope` is a filter, not a permission gate: every signed-in caller may list all apps.

parameters.name: scope

schema.description: `mine` lists the caller's own apps; `all` lists every app. A missing or unknown value means `mine`.

parameters.description: `mine` lists the caller's own apps; `all` lists every app. A missing or unknown value means `mine`.

patch.description:
Only the keys present are applied: an absent key is unchanged, `null` clears it.

Requires ownership of the app, or the platform-admin role.

403.description: The caller does not own the app and is not a platform admin (`forbidden`).

post.description:
The edge then answers the app's host with 410. Idempotent. Cancellation of the app's running jobs is delivered asynchronously.

Requires ownership of the app, or the platform-admin role.

403.description: The caller does not own the app and is not a platform admin (`forbidden`).

post.description:
Idempotent.

Requires ownership of the app, or the platform-admin role.

403.description: The caller does not own the app and is not a platform admin (`forbidden`).

get.description: The app's visibility and capability grants. Each provider-bound origin reports whether its approval is still effective.

put.description:
Baseline changes commit immediately. Elevated changes are bundled into one pending approval request.

Requires ownership of the app, or the platform-admin role.

200.description: The resulting manifest, the baseline changes applied now, and the id of the approval request opened for elevated changes (or null).

400.description: The request failed validation, a requested job type is not available, or a provider binding is invalid (`validation_failed`).

403.description: The caller does not own the app and is not a platform admin (`forbidden`).

409.description: The app's policy changed concurrently (`conflict`).

post.summary: Request one external origin for an app
post.description:
Adding an origin is always elevated, so this opens an approval request.

Requires ownership of the app, or the platform-admin role.

200.description: The resulting manifest, the baseline changes applied now, and the id of the approval request opened for elevated changes (or null).

400.description: The request failed validation, a requested job type is not available, or a provider binding is invalid (`validation_failed`).

403.description: The caller does not own the app and is not a platform admin (`forbidden`).

409.description: The app's policy changed concurrently (`conflict`).

post.summary: Change how an app gates access
post.description:
Reducing exposure commits immediately. Going public opens an approval request. Password visibility is enabled through the password-access route instead.

Requires ownership of the app, or the platform-admin role.

200.description: The app, the change applied now, and the id of the approval request opened (or null).

403.description: The caller does not own the app and is not a platform admin, or public apps are disabled on this deployment (`forbidden`).

409.description: Password visibility was requested, or the app's policy changed concurrently (`conflict`).

post.description:
Switches the app to password visibility and mints a passphrase. Idempotent: when password access is already enabled, the existing credential is returned.

Requires ownership of the app, or the platform-admin role.

403.description: The caller does not own the app and is not a platform admin, or password apps are disabled on this deployment (`forbidden`).

409.description: The app's access mode changed concurrently (`conflict`).

get.description: Requires ownership of the app, or the platform-admin role.

403.description: The caller does not own the app and is not a platform admin (`forbidden`).

404.description: No app has this slug, or password access is not enabled (`not_found`).

delete.description:
Reverts the app to internal visibility and deletes the credential. Idempotent: an app without password access is left unchanged.

Requires ownership of the app, or the platform-admin role.

403.description: The caller does not own the app and is not a platform admin (`forbidden`).

409.description: The app's access mode changed concurrently (`conflict`).

post.description:
Omit the body or `password` to generate a passphrase; supply one to set it.

Requires ownership of the app, or the platform-admin role.

403.description: The caller does not own the app and is not a platform admin, or password apps are disabled on this deployment (`forbidden`).

409.description: Password access is not enabled, or the app's access mode changed concurrently (`conflict`).

get.description: With `app`, lists that app's requests; the caller must own the app or be a platform admin. Without it, lists the global queue, which requires the platform-admin role. Requests in the global queue carry prior-decision context for their app.

parameters.name: app

schema.description: Only this app's requests, by slug.

parameters.description: Only this app's requests, by slug.

parameters.name: status

schema.description: Only requests in this lifecycle state.

parameters.description: Only requests in this lifecycle state.

403.description: The caller does not own the app, or lists the global queue, and is not a platform admin (`forbidden`).

post.description:
Applies the request's changes to the app and closes it, in one transaction. When a value the request touches changed since it was filed, the request moves to `needs_changes` instead. Repeating an approve that already landed is a no-op.

Requires the platform-admin role.

403.description: The caller is not a platform admin, filed the request themselves, the request predates requester ids, or it would make the app public on a deployment that disallows public apps (`forbidden`).

404.description: No approval request has this id (`not_found`).

409.description: The request was already decided differently, a bound provider changed since filing, or the app's policy changed concurrently (`conflict`).

post.description:
A note is required. Repeating a deny that already landed is a no-op.

Requires the platform-admin role.

400.description: The request failed validation, or carries no note (`validation_failed`).

403.description: The caller is not a platform admin, filed the request themselves, or the request predates requester ids and cannot be decided (`forbidden`).

404.description: No approval request has this id (`not_found`).

409.description: The request was already decided differently (`conflict`).

post.summary: Send a request back for changes
post.description:
A note is required. Repeating this decision after it landed is a no-op.

Requires the platform-admin role.

400.description: The request failed validation, or carries no note (`validation_failed`).

403.description: The caller is not a platform admin, filed the request themselves, or the request predates requester ids and cannot be decided (`forbidden`).

404.description: No approval request has this id (`not_found`).

409.description: The request was already decided differently (`conflict`).

post.description: Only the requester may withdraw. Repeating a withdraw that landed is a no-op.

403.description: The caller is not the requester, or the request predates requester ids and cannot be withdrawn (`forbidden`).

404.description: No approval request has this id (`not_found`).

409.description: The request was already decided (`conflict`).

Issues a new plaintext for the token and renews its lifetime, keeping its origins. The body is optional.

Requires ownership of the app, or the platform-admin role.

Requires the platform-admin role.

Requires `confirmInvalidation`: deletion always invalidates the provider's connections and pending consent attempts. Repeating the deletion of an id removed here answers `already_removed`.

Requires the platform-admin role.

get.description: What an app on this deployment can request, and which requests approve automatically. Instance-wide, not per app. Backs `helix capabilities`.
The deploy skill rendered for this deployment's addresses. The portal origin is taken from the request.

The topology the portal SPA and the CLI bootstrap from: the apps base, the deploy limits, and which optional surfaces are enabled. Public, and answers whether or not an IdP is configured. An optional field is omitted when its surface is not enabled.
Public. The CLI bootstraps sign-in from here, so its only configuration is the portal URL.

post.summary: Upload a bundle as a new preview version
post.description:
The new version is a preview; promote it to make it live.

Requires ownership of the app, or the platform-admin role.

201.description: The new version and any CSP warnings.

400.description: The request has no `bundle` file, or the bundle failed validation (`bundle_invalid`).

403.description: The caller does not own the app and is not a platform admin (`forbidden`).

409.description: The app is archived, or a version number could not be allocated (`conflict`).

413.description: The bundle is larger than the upload limit (`bundle_invalid`).

get.description: Newest first.

post.description:
Promoting the version that is already live returns the app unchanged.

Requires ownership of the app, or the platform-admin role.

schema.description: The version number, a positive integer.

parameters.description: The version number, a positive integer.

post.description:
Without `toNumber`, rolls back to the most recently archived version, the one live before the current one. Rolling back to the live version returns the app unchanged.

404.description: No app has this slug, or the app has no such version (`not_found`).

409.description: The app is archived, or there is no earlier version (`conflict`).

post.description: Called by a GitHub Actions job on the app's bound repository and branch, with the job's OIDC token as the bearer token (ADR-0051). Creates a preview version only.

bundle.description: The app bundle, a zip archive. It must be the only file part.

201.description: The new version and any CSP warnings.

400.description: The request has no `bundle` file, or the bundle failed validation (`bundle_invalid`).

403.description: The token's repository, branch, workflow or environment does not match the app's repo binding, or no app with this slug accepts repo deploys (`forbidden`).

409.description: The app is archived, the token has already deployed a version, or a version number could not be allocated (`conflict`).

413.description: The bundle is larger than the upload limit (`bundle_invalid`).

503.description: The directory did not answer; retry shortly (`capability_unavailable`).

get.description: Resolves the group ids stored on the app to display names. Ids that do not resolve are left out. When the deployment restricts directory search, the caller must own the app or be a platform admin; otherwise any authenticated caller may read it.

200.description: The app's groups that resolved. `available: false` means the directory is not configured or not consented, and the caller should offer manual group-id entry.

403.description: Directory search is restricted, and the caller does not own the app and is not a platform admin (`forbidden`).

429.description: The caller's directory lookup budget is spent (`rate_limited`).

503.description: The directory did not answer; retry shortly (`capability_unavailable`).

get.description: Resolves the group claim on the caller's verified token. Not subject to the directory-search policy.

200.description: The caller's groups that resolved. `available: false` means the directory is not configured or not consented, and the caller should offer manual group-id entry.

429.description: The caller's directory lookup budget is spent (`rate_limited`).

503.description: The directory did not answer; retry shortly (`capability_unavailable`).

get.description: The caller's own connected accounts, newest first, as metadata only. Each entry names the apps that use the connection's provider.

delete.summary: Disconnect one of the caller's connections
delete.description: Invalidates the connection, cancels its pending consent attempts, and audits the removal in one transaction. A repeat answers `already_removed`.

200.description: Whether this call removed the connection.

404.description: The caller has no connection with this id (`not_found`).

get.description: The portal API's OpenAPI 3.1 document for this portal's own release. Public: the document describes routes, not data.

ConfirmationRequiredError.description: A change that invalidates connections was sent without `confirmInvalidation`.

bearer.description: An IdP-issued token from `helix login`, or a portal dev token.

oidcCi.description: A GitHub Actions OIDC token for a repo-backed app (ADR-0051).
